common.demoDataNotice: Civic Technology Prototype — Verifiable Multi-Tier Public Administration Data

home.badge: Civic Technology Prototype — India-Wide Public Grievance Platform
home.headline: Your City. Your Voice. Better Public Services.
home.subheading: Report civic problems in seconds, track progress transparently, and see how communities are improving their surroundings.
home.step1Desc: Upload grievance photos and pinpoint location. AI assists in detecting category.
home.step2Desc: Auto-dispatches to the nearest eligible department office with SLA calculation.
home.step3Desc: Staff must submit photo evidence. Automated escalation triggers if SLA is breached.

report.title: File a Civic Grievance
report.subtitle: Provide issue details, location, and photos for immediate public action.
report.issueTitlePlaceholder: e.g., Deep pothole causing skidding on main road
report.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the exact problem, hazard level, and any landmarks...
report.pinpointMap: Click on map to adjust exact pin
report.photoNote: PNG, JPG up to 5MB. Clear evidence speeds up verification.
report.duplicateDetectedDesc: A similar open complaint was already reported nearby. You can support this existing complaint to prioritize it, or proceed with submitting a new one.

track.title: Track Your Complaint
track.subtitle: Enter your unique reference tracking ID (e.g., FMC-2026-XXXX) to view live progress.
track.notFound: No grievance found with this reference number.
track.escalatedNotice: This complaint has been escalated to Senior Administration due to SLA delay.

employee.title: Department Operational Queue
employee.subtitle: Resolve grievances assigned to your authorized public department.
employee.noAssignedComplaints: No complaints pending in your department queue.

admin.title: Executive Command Center
admin.subtitle: System-wide SLA monitoring, department performance, and escalation oversight across jurisdictions.

auth.mandatoryIdentitySubtitle: All citizen grievance reports require verified identity to ensure administrative accountability and prevent automated spam.
auth.methodMobileOtpDesc: Verified mobile possession authentication. Authorized for civic grievance tracking in this deployment.
auth.methodAadhaarDesc: Statutory verification under Section 4(3) of the Aadhaar Act, 2016.
auth.providerUnconfigured: UIDAI AUA/KUA Provider Not Configured (Prototype Deployment)
auth.providerUnconfiguredNotice: Production Aadhaar verification requires an authorized AUA/KUA gateway with official e-KYC clearance and gazette notification. To protect citizen privacy, raw Aadhaar numbers or biometrics are never stored.
auth.switchToMobileOtp: Authenticate via Active Mobile OTP Gate
